entities.name: Andra
entities.description: A young Bane Alley broker and member of House Dimir.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The guild Andra belongs to, which wanted a dagger sold.

entities.name: Bartek
entities.description: A young man who bought the dagger from Andra and was mugged.

events.summary: Andra sets up a stall in Bane Alley to broker a polished dagger that House Dimir wants sold.
events.quote: All she knew was that House Dimir wanted it sold to someone in particular

events.summary: Bartek brings Andra a gift and buys the dagger for five zinos, thinking she is romantically interested.
events.quote: He bought the dagger off her for five zinos, believing she had an actual romantic interest in him

events.summary: Andra arranges for Bartek to be mugged so the dagger is taken, sparing his life.
events.quote: she had arranged for him to receive a mugging the following day

events.summary: Bartek returns bruised, ignorant of who mugged him; Andra tallies her earnings.
events.quote: The total earnings for the setup were 25 zinos

relations.quote: Bane Alley broker and member of House Dimir
